Date: 2026-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short blurb + permission to publish pilot metrics

Hi Elena —

Huge thank you again to the BrightWorks team for running the two-week pilot with us. The results look great and we wanted to ask a quick favor that helps both teams: would BrightWorks be willing to provide a 1–2 sentence customer blurb and grant permission for Redwood to publish a short case spotlight that cites the pilot metrics listed in the attached PDF?

Recap of key pilot metrics (from attachment):
- Average inference latency reduced from 320ms -> 120ms (p95) on typical queries
- Token cost per 1k reduced ~28% after batching and KV caching
- End-to-end throughput increased 3.2x for peak window

What we’d like from you if possible:
1) A 1–2 sentence quote we can attribute to BrightWorks (name + title OK). Example: "Redwood helped us cut inference latency and cost while maintaining output quality."
2) Explicit permission to cite the metrics above and to use your company name/logo in a short customer spotlight and sales-facing one-pager.
3) If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-minute call to draft the blurb together.

Attached: pilot_metrics_summary.pdf with full numbers, and a short blurb template. We can also send legal-friendly language if your GC needs it.

Thanks — appreciate the consideration.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
